1_mechanical.detail: JSON valid, 12/12 keys present with no additions or drops; ICU parsed with @formatjs/icu-messageformat-parser from the repo's own dependency; AST shape identical to English for all 12 (only argument is {material} in state.cancelled_batch, select with exactly video|voiceover|sound_effect|other, each branch a non-empty complete sentence); open/close brace counts equal and no brace leak; no ICU plural in this slice so fr CLDR categories (one/many/other, never few) are vacuous here; no markup/Rich tags, backticks, commands, flags or identifiers to preserve; 4 negative controls each failed as required (drop the other branch -> MISSING_OTHER_CLAUSE; rename {material}->{media} -> STRUCTURE mismatch; ASCII space before ';' + straight apostrophe -> 2 TYPO failures; English left in error_class.unknown_tool -> ENGLISH byte-identical).

2_accuracy.detail: cancel.queued keeps the flat, unhedged no-charge promise of the one case allowed to make it; cancel.running keeps the request framing, the missing endpoint and the CONDITIONAL charge ('sera facturée si elle produit un audio'), adding no guarantee and no softening; settlement.pending states an outstanding charge and never an amount or zero; cancel.checking is a complete sentence with its own full stop (rendered space-joined after cancel.running at image-gen-card.tsx:341); denied (Refusé) vs gate_failed (Échec du contrôle) and unknown_tool vs invalid_arguments stay distinguishable; no negation, polarity, omission or addition found.

3_idiom_register.detail: vous throughout, lowercase mid-sentence; imperative for the action ('Patientez un instant et réessayez.'); terse participles for statuses per the style guide, no 'Veuillez…', no padded 'a bien été'; sentence case everywhere, labels carry no full stop, sentences do; reads as native product copy rather than calque. The feminine participle in cancel.queued matches the grammatical subject (la génération) and the shipped precedent transcript.stopped_before_finishing = 'Arrêtée avant la fin'; the masculine in state.cancelled_batch agrees with 'lot' — both correct, and the two are different subjects, not an inconsistency.

4_terminology.detail: Matches the shipped fr corpus and the glossary: fournisseur (stop_hint_queued, sound.stop.warning), endpoint kept Latin (guide kept-English list), facturée + frais finaux (sound.stop.warning, sound.cost.estimated_zero 'frais finaux non confirmés'), arrêt/arrêté (not annulation) for the stop, lot + the four material nouns reused verbatim from shipped done_batch/failed_batch ('Lot de vidéos', 'Lot de voix off', 'Lot d’effets sonores', 'Lot d’images'), ID uppercase (ui.agents.settings.general.id), audio kept, tool->outil per glossary. Two decisions are new to the corpus and are recorded as F1/F2 nits, not violations: 'règlement' (0 of 467 shipped keys) and 'contrôle' for a policy gate (corpus precedent exists for contrôle as a check: ui.updates.panel.seal.startup.message).

5_fit.detail: Measured cells (U+202F counts one): labels 6/12/13/17/18/19 vs English 6/12/11/17/18/18 — no label exceeds 19 cells and none is near a wrap point; the six wrapping sentences run +1 to +37% over English inside the card, which carries no maxChars/maxCells hint in the sidecar; state.cancelled_batch branches 21/23/28/20 cells vs English 20/24/27/20. No wide-glyph or combining-mark risk: every value is NFC-stable with no CJK/Devanagari. No overflow finding.

6_rtl.detail: Locale fr is LTR; bidi isolation at the call site is unaffected.
